stageNotes: Stage 1 — canonical: https://northprosports.com (apex 200, www 200 both clean; no <link rel='canonical'> declared; preserved input apex)

Stage 2 — WAF: hasWaf=false, hasCaptcha=false, ageGate.detected=false. Server: Apache, no CDN headers anywhere in 8-batch probe, no plugin WAF markers in any 403 (no 403s fired). XSS query returned 200 with 14-byte body — that's a PHP query-filter result page (empty search), not a WAF block.

Stage 3 — platform: opencart (Powered By OpenCart commented in footer + index.php?route= URL scheme everywhere + OCSESSID session cookies + standard <select id='input-sort'>/<select id='input-limit'> markup). adapterType=generic-retail (generic-retail.ts:75-76,958-959 has [class*='product-thumb'] and [class*='product-layout'] OpenCart selectors). needsPlaywright=false (HTML rendered server-side, plain curl returns full product cards). No age-gate.

Stage 4 — catalogUrls: 8 top-level categories discovered via main-nav crawl. Excluded /path=32 CLOTHING & FOOTWEAR (pure apparel, out of scope) and /path=1088 CURRENT REBATES (promo aggregator). The 6 firearm-relevant catalogUrls (28/766/267/552/45/400) walked at ?limit=1000 — server honored limit and returned entire categories in single requests (340/345/352/168/585/292 products respectively). Pairwise overlap measured: only 4 duplicate IDs across all 6 categories (sum=2082, union=2078). No firearm-relevant category is redundant; each contributes hundreds of unique IDs. extractionTested=true with 3 sample products having title/price/url; stockStatus=unknown because OpenCart listing markup has no per-card stock badge (category is named 'IN STOCK' implying merchant policy).

Stage 5 — pagination: ?page={N}, query-form. Verified by fetching page 2 of cat 28 — returned 100 products, zero overlap with page 1. perPage=100 is the <select id='input-limit'> default and largest visible option; ?limit=500 and ?limit=1000 are also server-honored (verified on cat 28 and cat 45). Shipping perPage=100 as the conservative baseline; catalogUrls bake limit=100 for predictability.

Stage 6 — sort: Mistake 21 hidden option verified. Visible <select id='input-sort'> options are only sort_order/name/price/model — no date-added option. Direct probe of ?sort=p.date_added&order=DESC returned distinct first products (24240 vs default 22944 vs price-ASC 21032) confirming the param is honored. ?sort=p.product_id&order=DESC also works but product_id is NOT chronological at NPS (first ID 5242 — lower than default — so product_id was not used for watermark). sortParam='?sort=p.date_added&order=DESC', sortVerified=true.

Stage 7 — watermark: navigate-from-watermark. Method A (api-date-since-watermark) unavailable — OpenCart has no public REST endpoint for date-since filtering. Method B preconditions satisfied: sort verified honored + IDs monotonic across pages (date-DESC page 1 ends at ID 23103, page 2 starts at ID 23102). reason field populated.

Stage 8 — count: 2078 from Stage 4d walk-derived union. No single-URL probe source exists. /sitemap.xml returns 404; OpenCart sitemap plugin route /index.php?route=extension/feed/google_sitemap returns 200 OK but with empty body. productCountMethod set to html-pagination as best-fit placeholder but flagged in fieldConfidence as 'low' — recommend operator either skip runtime count probe or add a new sum-across-urls method.
Stage 9 — assembly: validator pass expected (9 required fields populated; 7 recommended fields populated).
